extractions.description: An empirical computing study of a revised column-generation matheuristic for training univariate binary classification trees, evaluated with CPU experiments on 12 UCI datasets using CART, mathematical-programming solvers, preprocessing, pricing, and cut-generation procedures.

type.quote: We computationally show the significant benefits of our approach with respect to Firat et al. (2020) on datasets from the literature.
